title: Ilya Sutskever (OpenAI Chief Scientist) — Why next-token prediction could surpass human intelligence
summary: Dwarkesh Patel interviews OpenAI chief scientist Ilya Sutskever on time to AGI, what comes after generative models, data limits, alignment, and competing with Google. The title centers on whether next-token prediction could surpass human intelligence.
why: HN commenters cite it mainly for Sutskever's statements that training data is far from exhausted.

quote.text: Ilya Sutskever from OpenAI saying that the data situation is good and there's more data to train on
